environment: Windows, Conan Release, Qt offscreen, QT_FONT_DPI=96, default Windows text backend, 960x900 DPR1
methodology: One sequential fresh-process sample per size, without a concurrent build/test. Same fixed CSS and workload as round 9. Stage exclusive times exclude nested scopes. Working-set measurements are point-in-time, not peak. This diagnostic is not a statistical latency guarantee or a full GUI benchmark.
scope: Counter candidate filtering, immutable counter programs with scope-state memoization and exact selector dependency inputs, negative sibling tag probes, bounded shadow rasters, and temporary prototype cache lifetimes.

edit_stages.edit: Original baseline stage: inserts Edited inside the initial heading title, then applies the local range/block rebuild.
edit_stages.edit_plain: New stage, after edit: inserts Plain edit inside the first paragraph. No old baseline sample exists for this stage.
edit_stages.edit_numbering: New stage, after edit_plain: inserts a new h1 at the beginning and propagates subsequent counter values. No old baseline sample exists for this stage.
